item.title: Sir Patrick Stewart dies aged 86 as Sir Ian McKellen leads tributes
item.body: The actor died in Los Angeles following "a brief and poignant journey" with Alzheimer's Disease and Lewy Body Dementia. Sir Ian McKellen led tributes to his "beloved actor" colleague.

photo.credit: Kingkongphoto & www.celebrity-photos.com from Laurel Marylan / CC BY-SA 2.0, Wikimedia Commons

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🎭 Sir Patrick Stewart dies aged 86 as Sir Ian McKellen leads tributes

The actor died in Los Angeles following "a brief and poignant journey" with Alzheimer's Disease and Lewy Body Dementia. Sir Ian McKellen led tributes to his "beloved actor" colleague.

Source: BBC | Image: Kingkongphoto & www.celebrity-photos.com from Laurel Marylan / CC BY-SA 2.0, Wikimedia Commons
